'''Penovia''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Recopi]] in the [[Recopi system/Legends|Recopi system]],<ref name="CW" /> located in the portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region that was known as the [[Arrowhead]], or Inner Core,<ref name="Region" /> within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Penovia had fourteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Recopi system/Legends|Recopi system]] were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Recopi star system in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
